title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
title_zh: MORSE：通过开放世界自动研究优化流式视频记忆设计
abstract_en: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.
abstract_zh: 流式视频系统必须在帧存储容量有限、尚不知道未来问题的情况下，单遍决定保留哪些证据。现有递归自我改进方法虽能根据失败案例自动修改证据存取模块（harness），但修复方案仍受编辑器已有知识和预设工具的限制。MORSE（Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement）提出开放世界自动研究框架：先按原因归类训练记录中的失败案例，再针对反复出现的问题在线检索论文、模型卡和代码，寻找可改造的方法或可直接使用的预训练感知模型。引入新感知能力后，MORSE 还可同步调整证据的存储与检索方式，而无需更新视频语言模型的权重。它在留出的验证视频流上先筛选能提升回答质量的改动，再在指定容差内寻找保留这些收益且响应更快的方案。在三个流式视频基准上，MORSE 在各自使用相同冻结骨干的对比中均取得最高回答准确率。在 OVO-Bench 上，搭配 Qwen3-VL-8B 时，平均每次查询耗时 0.30 秒，准确率为 75.1%，比使用相同冻结骨干的次优受测方案高 3.1 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 针对单遍处理、帧预算有限且未来问题未知的流式视频问答，优化证据的保留与检索。
按成因归类训练中的失败案例，围绕重复失败在线搜索论文、模型卡和代码，突破预设工具限制。
引入预训练感知模型时，可同步修改证据存取模块，视频语言骨干保持冻结。
在留出验证流上先提升回答质量，再在指定容差内缩短响应时间。
三个基准的同骨干对比中均获最高准确率；OVO-Bench 上搭配 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到 75.1%，平均每次查询耗时 0.30 秒。
